name: Arkade Developers Ltd
title: Arkade Developers Ltd - 544261 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Real estate developer; FY26 pre-sales Rs 901 cr (+17%) and Q4 pre-sales Rs 303 cr (+40%), but PAT only Rs 5 cr after Rs 182 cr one-off tenancy-rights write-off; no supply or capacity discipline evidence.

triggers.label: PAT Rs 5 cr after Rs 182 cr write-off
triggers.quote: Profit after tax for FY25-26 stood at Rs. 5 crores, which is after giving the effect of exceptional item, which is a diminishing value of tenancy rights of Rs. 182 crores
triggers.highlight: Profit after tax for FY25-26 stood at Rs. 5 crores

triggers.label: Q4 pre-sales Rs 303 cr, +40% YoY
triggers.quote: We achieved highest-ever quarterly pre-sales of Rs. 303 crores for Q4 FY26, a growth of 40% on year-on-year basis
triggers.highlight: highest-ever quarterly pre-sales of Rs. 303 crores

triggers.label: May pre-sales slower post Q4
triggers.quote: They are a little slow because of the war impact and the fuel prices impact and the global economical situation.

guidance.quote: EBITDA margin is expected to stabilize around 27-28%. PAT margin is expected to stabilize at around 18-19%.
So, we expect about 20-25% growth year-on-year basis.
we are looking at launching it by this year-end, financial year-end.

red_flags.label: Rs 182 cr exceptional write-off wipes out profit
red_flags.quote: resulting in one-time exceptional accounting impact of Rs. 182.17 crores in the consolidated financial statements

red_flags.label: Inconsistent guidance: 25% vs 27-28% margin and 20-25% vs 'exponential'
red_flags.quote: Yes, Thane and Filmistan projects and other two cluster redevelopment projects will make the growth exponential.

red_flags.label: Filmistan valuation inconsistency: Rs 182.6 cr vs Rs 183 cr vs Rs 182.17 cr
red_flags.quote: The tenancy rights were valued at approximately Rs. 182.6 crores.

red_flags.label: Revenue timeline questions unanswered: ~12,000 cr pipeline over 5-6 years
red_flags.quote: We have a pipeline of about Rs. 12,000 crores spread over the next 5-6 years.

evasions.topic: Revenue growth and cumulative revenue math
evasions.quote: Cumulative compounding factor, if you calculate either.

evasions.topic: Filmistan write-off treatment and tenancy rights valuation
evasions.quote: So, whatever we have considered in this year as a cost, it will reduce the project cost for the Filmistan project going forward.
